subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: For this xAI/Grok stale encrypted_content recovery, should maintainers accept redacted pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative predicate tests as the proof gate, or require organic after-fix xAI logs before merge?
rationale: The reported code-less error appears tied to provider snapshot/key rotation, so a faithful live after-fix capture is not readily inducible by the contributor or reviewer, but the normal external-PR proof gate still expects after-fix real behavior evidence.

options.title: Accept a narrow proof override
options.body: Treat the production pre-fix logs plus focused predicate tests as sufficient for this provider-rotation-only case and land after a clean refreshed review.

options.title: Require organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future xAI rotation produces redacted logs or terminal output showing the stripped retry succeeds.

options.title: Defer to broader breaker design
options.body: Do not land the predicate-only fix and instead pursue a larger provider error classification design before changing recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept a narrow proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the production pre-fix logs plus focused predicate tests as sufficient for this provider-rotation-only case and land after a clean refreshed review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the existing retry predicate/test surface and recently refactored the same OpenAI transport boundary, making them the best history-backed owner for the proof-sufficiency decision.
